title: TaskPacket
description: Universal Delivery Pack Specification v1.0 atomic task packet contract consumed by autonomous coding agents and execution engines.

taskId.description: Unique task identifier formatted as TASK-XXX, or TASK-XXX.N for a sub-task of TASK-XXX (specification 1.1.0).

reviewerChecklist.description: Optional (specification 1.1.0). Checklist a reviewer ticks off for a sub-task: criteria met, tests present and passing, decisions respected, out-of-scope untouched, no unrelated changes.

parentTaskId.description: Optional (specification 1.1.0). The task this one is a sub-task of. Absent or null for a primary task. The parent MUST be a task in the pack, the chain of parents MUST NOT loop, and a sub-task MUST list its parent in dependsOn.

title.description: Short imperative summary of the task objective.

outcome.description: Tangible deliverable produced upon task completion.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the task.

parallelSafe.description: Whether this task can run concurrently with other tasks at the same tier.

humanApprovalRequired.description: Whether explicit human approval is required before applying or merging changes produced by this task. Required, so that no consumer has to guess a default; a consumer MUST stop for approval when it is true.

dependsOn.description: Task IDs that must complete before this task can start.

unlocks.description: Task IDs enabled when this task completes.

path.description: Relative workspace path; path traversal outside repository root is prohibited.

inputs.description: Input files, specifications, or contracts read by the agent during this task.

expectedOutputs.description: Expected output files, test suites, or artifacts generated by this task.

allowedCapabilities.description: Permitted runtime capabilities (e.g. filesystem:read, filesystem:write, process:build, process:test).

allowedChanges.description: Explicit actions permitted for the agent.

currentStateEvidence.description: Current repository reality before task starts.

changeContract.description: Interface, schema, or functional contracts altered.

implementationSteps.description: Ordered steps for coding agent execution.

securityConstraints.description: Explicit security rules and isolation constraints enforced for this task.

executable.description: Program to run, as a single word with no whitespace or shell metacharacters. It is started directly with args; it is never passed to a shell.

args.description: Arguments, one array element per argument. No shell interpolation or expansion is applied.

workingDirectory.description: Directory relative to the repository root; null or absent means the root.

commands.description: Commands to compile, test and verify the work, as executable plus argument array.

artifactHashes.description: Map of relative artifact file paths to SHA-256 integrity hashes (64 hex characters).

definitionOfDone.description: Checklist required to declare task complete.
